sourceText:
Orange Dream Bars
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:14pm

Ingredients




1 cup flour
1/4 cup confectioner's sugar
1/2 cup butter
2 eggs
1 tablespoon grated orange zest
2 tablespoons orange juice
1 cup sugar
2 tablespoons flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
Orange icing:

1 cup confectioner's sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons orange juice

Preparation

1 Combine first three ingredients in small mixing bowl until mixture is crumbly. Press into the bottom of greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Beat eggs in small mixing bowl until foamy. Add remaining ingredients (minus the icing); beat well. Pour over crust. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and frost. Cut into bars 2 To make the orange icing, combine the confectioner's sugar, vanilla and butter. Add orange juice until of spreading consistency.

About


From the Occident/King Midas Collector's Bake Book.
